test_cases.steps: On any step, leave required fields empty and click Next.
test_cases.expected: Errors shown on all empty required fields. Step does not advance.

test_cases.scenario: Theme toggle works on wizard page
test_cases.steps: Click the theme toggle in header.
test_cases.expected: Theme switches between light and dark. Preference persists on page refresh.

test_cases.scenario: Responsive layout stacks on mobile
test_cases.steps: Resize browser to < 900px width.
test_cases.expected: Sidebar collapses or stacks above the step content. Wizard remains usable.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking Finish triggers progress modal
test_cases.steps: Complete all steps. Click Finish.
test_cases.expected: Progress modal appears with 'Setting up Resource Planner...' message. Finish button becomes disabled.

test_cases.scenario: Progress modal shows step-by-step indicators
test_cases.steps: Observe modal during setup.
test_cases.expected: Each backend step (infra, database, logging, etc.) appears in modal and updates as it completes.

test_cases.scenario: Progress modal polls status until complete
test_cases.steps: Observe modal during setup.
test_cases.expected: Modal polling increments step status approximately every 600ms.

test_cases.scenario: Successful setup shows completion state
test_cases.steps: Setup completes successfully.
test_cases.expected: Modal shows 'Setup complete!' message. 'Go to Login' button appears.

test_cases.scenario: 'Go to Login' redirects to login page
test_cases.steps: Click 'Go to Login' in modal.
test_cases.expected: Redirected to /login/.

test_cases.scenario: All configurations persisted — verify on login
test_cases.steps: Complete setup, login as admin.
test_cases.expected: Admin account works. App name configured correctly.

test_cases.scenario: Setup failure shows error state in modal
test_cases.steps: Cause a backend failure. Click Finish.
test_cases.expected: Modal shows 'Setup failed' with error message.

test_cases.scenario: Finish button re-enabled after failure
test_cases.steps: Observe Finish button after setup failure.
test_cases.expected: Finish button becomes enabled again, allowing retry.

test_cases.scenario: Setup can be retried after failure
test_cases.steps: Encounter failure. Correct the data. Click Finish again.
test_cases.expected: Setup re-runs. If successful, completes normally.

test_cases.scenario: Submitting twice simultaneously not possible
test_cases.steps: Click Finish. Immediately click Finish again.
test_cases.expected: Second click has no effect. Only one setup request in flight.

test_cases.scenario: Setup already complete returns conflict
test_cases.steps: Manually call POST /api/v1/setup/ after setup is complete.
test_cases.expected: API returns 409 Conflict. Frontend handles gracefully.

test_cases.scenario: Status endpoint returns correct phase names
test_cases.steps: Monitor network during submission.
test_cases.expected: GET /api/v1/setup/status/ returns phase keys: infra, database, logging, admin, app, auth, storage, email, complete.

test_cases.scenario: Wizard is usable at 1440px (desktop)
test_cases.steps: Open at 1440px width.
test_cases.expected: Two-column layout: sidebar left, step content right. All fields visible.

test_cases.scenario: Wizard is usable at 768px (tablet)
test_cases.steps: Resize to 768px.
test_cases.expected: Layout adapts. No content overflow. Navigation accessible.

test_cases.scenario: Wizard is usable at 375px (mobile)
test_cases.steps: Resize to 375px.
test_cases.expected: Single column. Step content stacks below navigation. Inputs are full-width. No horizontal scroll.

test_cases.scenario: All form fields have visible labels
test_cases.steps: Inspect each step.
test_cases.expected: Every input has a visible label. No inputs rely on placeholder text as the only label.

test_cases.scenario: Tab key navigates all interactive elements
test_cases.steps: On any step, press Tab repeatedly.
test_cases.expected: Focus moves through all fields, buttons, and links in logical order.

test_cases.scenario: Error messages are associated with their fields
test_cases.steps: Trigger validation errors. Inspect markup.
test_cases.expected: Error text is linked to the corresponding field (aria-describedby or similar).

test_cases.scenario: Password fields do not expose values in page source
test_cases.steps: Inspect DOM with browser devtools on step 1.
test_cases.expected: Password input type='password'. Value not in page source or data attributes.

test_cases.scenario: Secret fields (Client Secret, Access Key) masked by default
test_cases.steps: Inspect step 3 and step 5 OAuth fields.
test_cases.expected: Fields are type password by default. Eye icon required to reveal.

test_cases.scenario: AWS Access Key warning shown when credentials entered
test_cases.steps: Select AWS, choose Access Key mode.
test_cases.expected: Warning text about plaintext .env storage is visible.

test_cases.scenario: Dark mode applies consistently to wizard
test_cases.steps: Toggle to dark mode. Navigate through all 8 steps.
test_cases.expected: All step content, fields, panels, sidebar use dark theme. No light-mode remnants.

test_cases.scenario: Theme preference persists across page refresh
test_cases.steps: Toggle to dark mode. Refresh the page.
test_cases.expected: Dark mode remains active.

test_cases.scenario: Wizard loads within 2 seconds on local dev
test_cases.steps: Open DevTools Network tab. Load /setup/.
test_cases.expected: DOM interactive within 2 seconds on local network.

test_cases.scenario: Test connection button completes within 5 seconds
test_cases.steps: Click 'Test Connection' with a reachable server.
test_cases.expected: Response received and feedback shown within 5 seconds.
